scheduler_auto_shutdown.description: Automatically shut down the workflow after all tasks complete.

scheduler_try_1_max_submissions.description: Maximum number of task submission attempts (try 1).

scheduler_poll_interval.description: Interval in seconds between polling task states.

scheduler_cycle_point_delay.description: Delay in seconds between checking for new cycle points.

scheduler_max_active_cycle_points.description: Maximum number of active cycle points held in memory.

log_file_enable.description: Enable writing workflow logs to disk.

log_file_path.description: Path to the workflow log file (supports Cylc environment variables).

log_file_max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) before log rotation; 0 disables rotation.

tasks.description: List of task definitions (each task has its own configuration block).

task_name.description: Name of the task (used as section key in config).

environment.description: Key-value pairs of environment variables for the task.

script.description: The shell script to execute for the task.

batch_system.description: Batch system used to submit this task (if not local).

submit_command.description: Custom command to submit the task to a batch system (e.g., 'sbatch'). Optional.

retry.description: Delays (in seconds) between task retry attempts.
